answer.raw_answer:
## Summary
There is no record of a "municipal library" opening at Vostok Station in 2019, nor does such a facility exist at the station. Vostok Station is a specialized Russian scientific research base, not a municipality, and its infrastructure consists of research laboratories, drilling complexes, and living quarters for scientists and support staff [Trouble at the Vostok Station After investing millions in a brand-new ... — meduza.io](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2020/12/22/trouble-at-the-vostok-station).

## Facility Overview and Infrastructure
Vostok Station is a remote, isolated research facility located in the interior of Antarctica, founded in 1957 [Russia builds new 'Vostok' station - Polar Journal](https://polarjournal.net/russia-builds-new-vostok-station). It is not a town or city and therefore does not contain municipal infrastructure such as public libraries.

<details>
<summary>Nature of Vostok Station's "Library" and Facilities</summary>

The station functions exclusively as a scientific outpost. While researchers have access to books, these are limited to specialized technical and scientific literature required for their work, such as documentation on drilling complexes or international law [Polar scientists talk about a typical day at the Vostok research station — forpost-sz.ru](https://forpost-sz.ru/en/a/2022-10-13/polar-scientists-talk-about-typical-day-vostok-research-station). 

The station's primary purpose is scientific research, including meteorology, aerology, geophysics, and ice core studies [Trouble at the Vostok Station After investing millions in a brand-new ... — meduza.io](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2020/12/22/trouble-at-the-vostok-station). In 2019, the Russian government initiated plans to rebuild the station's aging infrastructure, which had been in disrepair, but this project focused on a new wintering complex for researchers, not public amenities [Trouble at the Vostok Station After investing millions in a brand-new ... — meduza.io](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2020/12/22/trouble-at-the-vostok-station).
</details>

## Clarification on Potential Misconceptions
The query likely conflates the station's scientific activities with public infrastructure. There is no evidence of any "municipal library" inauguration in 2019.

<details>
<summary>Distinguishing between research facilities and public institutions</summary>

*   **Scientific Focus:** Vostok Station is a research base. Its "library" is a collection of technical books for researchers, not a public facility [Polar scientists talk about a typical day at the Vostok research station — forpost-sz.ru](https://forpost-sz.ru/en/a/2022-10-13/polar-scientists-talk-about-typical-day-vostok-research-station).
*   **2019 Activity:** In 2019, the Russian government signed a decree to build a new wintering complex to replace the aging station, which had been largely buried under snow [Trouble at the Vostok Station After investing millions in a brand-new ... — meduza.io](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2020/12/22/trouble-at-the-vostok-station). There were no public events or library openings associated with this construction project.
*   **Ice Core Library:** While an "ice core library" was inaugurated in Antarctica by the Ice Memory Foundation, this occurred in January 2026 and is a scientific archive, not a municipal library [Inaugurated: Antarctica's first ice core library — seas.umich.edu](https://seas.umich.edu/news/inaugurated-antarcticas-first-ice-core-library).
</details>

## Key Takeaways
*   **No Municipal Library:** Vostok Station is a scientific research base and does not have a municipal library.
*   **2019 Context:** The only major activity regarding Vostok Station in 2019 was the government decree to modernize the station's aging wintering complex [Trouble at the Vostok Station After investing millions in a brand-new ... — meduza.io](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2020/12/22/trouble-at-the-vostok-station).
*   **Facility Type:** The station is an isolated, extreme-environment research facility with a limited population (typically 12–13 winterers and 35 summer researchers), making the concept of a municipal library inapplicable [Trouble at the Vostok Station After investing millions in a brand-new ... — meduza.io](https://meduza.io/en/feature/2020/12/22/trouble-at-the-vostok-station).
